chunks: Disputing with him, his companion said: 'Do you disbelieve in Him who created you from dust, then a drop of semen, then formed you into a man?'

key_terms.يُحَاوِرُهُ: Disputing with him / engaging in dialectical argument

ai.seo_question: What are the stages of human creation mentioned in the Quran according to this narration?
ai.summary: This narrative, often cited in Shia theological discourses on the resurrection (Ma'ad), highlights the logical progression from simple origins to complex human form as proof of divine omnipotence. The companion's argument underscores the Shia emphasis on the tangible signs of creation in the physical world as a bridge to metaphysical truth, reinforcing the belief that the One who initiated life can easily restore it.
